scope: Independent original-image visual review only; no art edits, approval or runtime testing.
method: Vision inspection of each individual original, not boards. Gabon marketing required lossless decode to PNG after two HTTP 400 failures. Read each source README; kept source assertions separate from visual findings.

observations.marketing: Off-white textured chest; green-capped faceted chalk cliffs, glossy turquoise inset, gray shoreline stones, brass corner caps/clasp and dark flint feet.
observations.desktop-closed: Cliff/shoreline identity retained; flatter turquoise water, pale matte body and strong dark lid seam; complete object and controls visible.
observations.desktop-open: Empty pale cavity and plain lid underside visible, rear brass hinge pieces and released tab; entire open silhouette framed.
observations.mobile-closed: Chalk cliffs and turquoise inset remain recognizable; seam appears slightly ajar, shoreline/hardware simplify at this size.
observations.mobile-open: Open cavity, brass hardware and dark feet visible without cropping; small connection details unresolved.

limitations: Faceted/repetitive cliffs and abstract green plateau, straight flat water boundary and conspicuous dark seam match disclosed source limitations.
Marketing has richer glossy water and surface detail than runtime; no unequivocal broken geometry established.

observations.marketing: Gray paneled chest, sage clay-like low caldera and rounded canopy cushions, green seam, brass latch/caps/lower trim and dark rock feet.
observations.desktop-closed: Low green relief/caldera and canopy clusters preserved; gray diagonally mottled body, brighter green vegetation and broad green closure strip; fully framed.
observations.desktop-open: Empty dark green-gray cavity and plain lid underside; rear hinges present, exact seating shadowed; controls match open state.
observations.mobile-closed: Terrain and brass chest silhouette readable but caldera/canopy details diminish; no crop or overflow.
observations.mobile-open: Open rim and empty cavity readable; dark floor boundaries weak, no obvious detached part or clipping.

limitations: Clay-like relief and cushion canopy are abstract rather than exposed basalt or individual rainforest trees; stone can read as wood/metal under lighting.
Broad green seam and dark open interior reduce construction/depth readability.

observations.marketing: Blush timber chest with three stylized tree groups on green islands, winding turquoise/cream lagoon inlay, brass latch/disc/side ring/caps and gray irregular feet; green seam visible.
observations.desktop-closed: Three tree groups and winding lagoon remain readable; light rose wood with regular grain, exposed green seam and dense front hardware; complete framing.
observations.desktop-open: Empty wood interior with green rim; hinges, front disc and side ring present; exact hinge seating ambiguous but no confirmed detachment.
observations.mobile-closed: Tree/lagoon identity clear at small scale; front latch/disc become crowded; entire model and controls fit.
observations.mobile-open: Open wood cavity, green edging and hardware visible; small joints and partially occluded feet unresolved; no crop.

limitations: Flat shallow ribbon water, simplified crowns, regular wood grain, prominent family hardware and irregular stone feet match source disclosures.
Runtime trees are more angular and saturated than soft sage marketing foliage; not a functional failure.
Green closed seam reads as exposed lining/gap rather than flush closure.

gabon.inspection_note: Original marketing.webp direct vision failed twice with HTTP 400. Successfully inspected its full-resolution 1072x976 decoded PNG, without resize/crop/art edits; PNG is in telegram2 scratch.

observations.marketing: Three green peaks with exposed pale rock patches and rounded lower clusters; mottled pink-brown chest, green seam, brass fittings/round disc/side ring and gray feet.
observations.desktop-closed: Three unequal highland ridges retained; earth-red mottled surface, conspicuous green gasket and clean brass; fully framed.
observations.desktop-open: Hollow empty mottled interior, green rim, raised plain lid and rear hinge pieces; full object and controls visible.
observations.mobile-closed: Peak silhouette reads clearly, fine lower vegetation less distinct; material can read as wood rather than mineral, weathering weak.
observations.mobile-open: Empty cavity visible though repeated mottling reduces depth separation; hardware looks applied-on, not demonstrably detached; no clipping.

limitations: Simple angular terrain, wood-like mineral reading, conspicuous green gasket and cleaner-than-weathered brass explicitly match README limitations.
Nimba is transboundary, not exclusive Guinea geography; stylized inspiration rather than survey or exact reconstruction.

observations.marketing: Broken ivory reef ring around pale turquoise lagoon, muted slate-blue lid, flowing blue body pattern, brass hardware and pale rock feet; channels visible but stylized.
observations.desktop-closed: Ivory atoll and pale opaque lagoon preserved; brighter cyan-blue body and gray-beige lid depart from midnight palette. Cyan seam has conspicuous stepped corner transitions.
observations.desktop-open: Lid appears suspended above rear rim; hinge pieces do not read as a continuous connection. Watery interior texture obscures floor/depth; full model fits.
observations.mobile-closed: Atoll concept recognizable, but individual channel continuity is ambiguous at small scale; flat lagoon resembles inlay. Complete model and controls fit.
observations.mobile-open: Floating-lid/weak hinge-connection appearance persists; top fitting isolated against background. Cavity visible but floor detail weak; no viewport crop.

defects.observation: Open lid/hinge connection looks floating/disconnected on both desktop and mobile.
Closed seam corner has interrupted/stepped trim appearance. Intended construction versus misalignment cannot be established from still.

limitations: Four channels are documented as geometry-tested, but not equally legible in supplied views; this review does not contradict those checks.
Opaque shallow lagoon, brighter body/paler lid, irregular feet and floating-looking inherited hinge are expressly disclosed by source README.
Marketing-to-runtime material differences do not independently establish a functional failure.
